procedural_matters: Technical committee(TC) was represented by Aileen Loo.
SRI 143696 was represented by Taalya Tranchell.
Kethaha Weerasuriga attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Equipment inspection was carried out by the technical committee (TC) in race 6 at the finishing line.
During the inspection of SRI 143696, the tail end of the control line of kicker was tied to the centerboard shock cord.
TC informed SRI 143696 the intention to protest immediately.
conclusions: By tying the tail end of the control line of kicker to the centerboard shock cord, SRI 143696 failed to comply with ILCA class rule CR3(b)x and RRS 78.1.
By sailing with tail ends of the control lines tied to shock cord, SRI 143696 did not compromise safety nor gain a competitive advantage.
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 5% was decided.
There are no facts to justify decreasing or increasing the penalty.
The penalty given to SRI 143696 is, 5% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method describe in RRS 44.3(c ) and applied to race 6, but not worse than the score for DNF.
